title: Icon Widget
subtitle: Render scalable vector symbols from the Material design library.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: The IconData symbol to render (typically from the Icons class).

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the icon in logical pixels. Defaults to 24.0.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The color used to paint the vector symbol.

properties.name: semanticLabel
properties.description: A text description of the icon for screen readers to assist in accessibility.
